title: Reference solution: Build a Monte Carlo experiment
answer:
import numpy as np

rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
x = rng.uniform(-1, 1, 100_000)
y = rng.uniform(-1, 1, 100_000)
inside = x*x + y*y <= 1
print(round(4 * inside.mean(), 3))
